Not having much luck with analog pedals (I've always been a digital guy), I decided to make an extremely flexible digital pedal to prototype new effects on. Enjoy. ## Details **Board Schematics** Please note that the version of the board I've made doesn't include some components shown on the schematic: - LED2 - SW2 - INPUT2 - OUTPUT2 - MIDI input I may include these in a future version of the pedal though! Both audio jacks are mono, although I used L/R jacks when I made the board. ## Files | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | ### any\_pedal\_design\_files.zip
